subject.title: test(extensions): derive Firecrawl batch expectations from tracked tests

question: Should this narrowly scoped inventory-driven test hardening be accepted as an exception to the default policy against standalone test-only pull requests?
rationale: The implementation and proof are adequate, but automation cannot decide whether the maintenance value warrants an exception to the repository’s contribution policy.

options.title: Accept the narrow exception
options.body: Merge the test-only change because it removes a concrete stale-inventory maintenance hazard without changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Enforce the default policy
options.body: Close the PR because the test cleanup is not coupled to a production fix or newly introduced behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow exception
recommendation.body: Merge the test-only change because it removes a concrete stale-inventory maintenance hazard without changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns repository-wide contribution policy and test-tooling maintenance rather than a Firecrawl runtime contract.
